### Contact form
- URL: https://hazonm.co.il/contact
- Endpoint: https://hazonm.co.il/api/email/contact-form
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Fields:
  - `name` (text, required)
  - `email` (email, required)
  - `phone` (tel, required)
  - `service` (select)
  - `message` (textarea)
  - `consent` (checkbox, required)
